title: Dungeons
description: Dungeon flags: 8 words per area, at 0x0A64 + area × 16, read through the game's dungeon-flag table (17 entries, right after the item-flag table in the executable). Word 7 is the rooms-visited mask for every area, not just dungeons. Labels marked probable come from comparing real saves.

fields.label: Boss defeated
fields.description: Dungeon flag 3 (the decompilation's boss-defeat tag checks it).

fields.label: Map (probable)
fields.description: Dungeon flag 2. Set for every dungeon in a completionist save; speedrun saves usually lack it.

fields.label: Boss key obtained (probable)
fields.description: Dungeon flag 12. Set wherever the boss door was opened normally.

fields.label: Boss key used (probable)
fields.description: Dungeon flag 16. Set together with flag 12.

fields.label: Unknown flag 4
fields.description: Dungeon flag 4. Seen only in Skyview Temple and the Ancient Cistern.

fields.label: Small keys held
fields.description: Dungeon flag 15, the small-key counter.

fields.label: Rooms visited (bitmask)
fields.description: Dungeon flag 8: one bit per room entered (room 0 = bit 0); full for a cleared dungeon, e.g. 0x07FF for Skyview's 11 rooms.
